description: Department of Fiscal Policy -  Notify the Annual Report issued under Section 13 of the Fiscal Management Responsibility) Act, No. 03 of 2003
categorisation: This gazette content announces the publication and availability of the Annual Report of the Ministry of Finance, issued under the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003. This constitutes a statutory instrument and regulatory matter, falling under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for legal notices and statutory declarations related to financial regulations.
